policy.approvalScope: All historic approvals preserved for original named subject/context only, no automatic new module approvals
policy.identity: Only physical museum object ID, matching exact object URL, or original SHA256 yields confirmed join. Unique artist/title matches are suggestions awaiting review.
policy.paintings: Do not count photographs/variants as distinct physical works; do not silently merge different works sharing title and artist.
policy.rights: Object-level CC0 is not final proof of the exact photograph and commercial reproduction. Final release requires photo/file licence checked.
policy.quality: No frames in derivative. Preserve painted edges; museum-quality faithful colour/detail; no glows and no photographed hanging pictures.
policy.reviewDecisions: 2026-10-28 user keep/reject/undecided per exact pool; do not promote to global rejection or auto approve elsewhere.
